summary: Pacific Airport Group (GAP) filed a Form 6-K with the SEC to announce the filing of its annual report for the year ended December 31, 2025, with Mexican regulators and its Form 20-F with the SEC. This routine disclosure of annual financial results does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or any other special situation. The filing is a standard reporting obligation for a foreign private issuer. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisor names are provided. There is no special-situation event to analyze or monitor.
